text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE to oncall: sa-east1 GPU pool 'sa-gpu-pool-1' exhausted, queue length rising > 12k, 503 spikes observed for chat/embeddings routes. Autoscaler attempted scale up x3 but failed: quota limit / failed allocations.

 diego (oncall): I'm on it. pulling metrics now. can someone post the autoscaler logs? :coffee:

 kyle (runtime): past 4m average token latency up 2.3x from 70ms->180ms. logs show OOM allocations on p4d and scale requests getting 'capacity_quota_exceeded'.

 nisha (sre): Confirming alerts: GPU-queue-growth, autoscale-fail, high-5xx-rate. Customers in SA seeing 503/504 on /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. ACME-ads and LocalBank report high error rates.

 emily (cs): ACME-ads just raised a P1 (support ticket #984321). They're seeing 40% of requests erroring. They asked for ETA.

 diego (oncall): ETA short-term: enable cross-region spillover to nearest healthy region (us-east1) and throttle best-effort tiers to preserve SLA traces. Initiating.

 kyle (runtime): Running routing toggle:
```
redwoodctl routing update --from-region sa-east1 --spillover-region us-east1 --policy immediate --max-concurrency 1200
```

 ops-bot: routing update accepted, policy applied (change-id 8f3b). Starting gradual reroute of new connections.

 sara (infra): Can we also increase queue-poller workers to drain backlog? risk: will request more GPUs and maybe hit same quota. I'd prefer routing + tiered-throttle.

 nisha (sre): Agreed. Applying rate-limits on non-enterprise plans:
```
redwoodctl rate set --route "*/best-effort/*" --qps 10 --burst 20 --until 1918506000
```

 ops-bot: rate config applied. Non-enterprise QPS reduced; enterprise routes unchanged.

 diego (oncall): Observing immediate effect: 5xx rate dropping from 38% -> 12% within 60s. Queue length plateauing, new request spillover to us-east1 at ~35% of traffic.

 emily (cs): Shared interim note with ACME-ads: "we've routed your traffic to nearest healthy region and applied temporary rate limits for non-SLA tiers; full remediation in progress." They acknowledged.

 kyle (runtime): Autoscaler failure root cause: cloud provider returned ENOSLOTS for p4-series. Filed ticket with provider (INC-44812). We also had a misconfigured scale policy allowing unlimited simultaneous scale requests leading to rapid quota consumption. Fixing policy.

 sara (infra): Patching autoscaler policy:
```
redwoodctl autoscaler update --pool sa-gpu-pool-1 --max-parallel-scale 2 --cooldown 120s
```

 ops-bot: autoscaler config updated (change-id 8f3c).

 nisha (sre): Next: confirm backlog drain. Diegos, keep watch. If spillover > 60% or latency > 300ms, trigger canary rollback of recent model flavor (northstar-v2) which is heavier.

 diego (oncall): Confirmed. backlog 12k -> 5.1k in 9 minutes. 5xx down to 4%. Latency back to ~95ms.

 emily (cs): ACME-ads updated: errors reduced to 7%, they asked for incident summary for legal/comms. I'll collect notes.

 kyle (runtime): Assigning postmortem: owner kyle (runtime). Timeline + remediation + action-items. Will include provider quota issues + autoscaler policy.

 sara (infra): I'm taking 30m handoff after Diego stabilizes. Diego, can you write a short runbook note for the handoff channel?

 diego (oncall): posting handoff note.

 diego (oncall): HANDOFF: sa-gpu incident. Current state: mitigated via spillover -> us-east1 + non-sla throttles. Backlog 4.3k and decreasing. Keeping autoscaler max-parallel-scale=2. Next steps: monitor provider ticket INC-44812, verify autoscaler behavior after cooldowns. Paging Sara in 30m. If regress, escalate to infra lead @sara.

 sara (infra): thanks. I'll take over in 30.

 ops-bot: incident status -> mitigated. Primary impact: degraded for SA customers for ~28 minutes, partial outages for best-effort tiers. Severity P1->P2. Postmortem owner: kyle (runtime). Follow-up ticket: PM-1904 (postmortem + supplier follow-up).

 nisha (sre): action items:
- (kyle) postmortem + provider follow-up (48h)
- (sara) adjust autoscaler defaults across regions (72h)
- (infra) create alert for 'scale quota exceeded' with runbook (24h)
- (cs) customer comms summary (2h)

 emily (cs): I'll draft the customer-facing note and share in #customer-comm.

 diego (oncall): handing off now. I'm available via DMs if needed. :thumbsup:

 sara (infra): taking lead. I'll keep channel updated and finalize rollout of autoscaler safeguards.

 incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated. Channel will remain open for follow-ups. Closed to active paging.
